# Third-party resources

- `src/theme/pangu.js` (ES module wrapper adapted from `pangu.min.js`): pangu.js 3.3.0, Vinta Chen, MIT; upstream https://github.com/vinta/pangu.js. Copied from the local WordPressGit reference theme, with the original notice intact.
- `wordpressgit-LICENSE`: GPL v2 licence supplied with the WordPressGit reference. `src/theme/fortunes.json` is the original theme's local fortune corpus. Attribution: WordPressGit (云落), https://coding.net/u/googlo/p/Git/git.

The PHP theme and its other scripts are not executed or loaded. Share controls and image dialog are newly implemented with browser APIs.
